title: T-cKS: Tail-Conditional KS Distance
summary: A research repository proposing T-cKS, a new statistical metric for evaluating conditional extreme tail-loss preservation in insurance synthetic data, tested against an Allstate insurance claims dataset. experiment_synthetic.py runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer (via sdv.single_table and sdv.metadata) to generate the synthetic data that the new metric is benchmarked on.
affiliations: Kyung Hee University, Department of Business Administration
evidence: experiment_synthetic.py:180-197 imports and instantiates GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table
